## Plan

No new language features this week. We will apply the programming concepts covered in the course to formulate problems, choose data representations, design algorithms and check proposed solutions.

- **Monday, November 2:** classroom team discussion, with a 40-minute breakout to develop a solution on paper.
- **Tuesday, November 3:** synthesis and presentations of findings by selected teams or individuals, followed by discussion.
